def maxProfit (prices: List Nat) (h_precond: maxProfit_precond prices) : Nat :=
  let maxPrices := prices.fold (λ acc pi: Nat, acc + pi) 0 in
  let possible_transactions := Map.singleton (0) in
  let add_transaction := ∕ in
  let handle_transaction :=
    fun (profits, prices) (pi, i) (pj, j) =>
      let profit := pj - pi in
      let valid_prices := prices.ignore i in
      let remaining_prices := prices.slice j valid_prices in
      valid_prices.fold (λ acc pj: Nat, acc +pj) 0 in
      let max_profits := Map.insert_mul (profit) (profits + 1) possible_transactions in
      let new_prices := valid_prices + [pj] in
      (max_profits, new_prices).snd
  in
  handle_transaction.fold (add_transaction) possible_transactions.maybe empty in
  possible_transactions.size.max 0.
